rubric.role_summary: Non-entry-level threat researcher investigating software supply-chain threats, analyzing malware in open-source ecosystems, building automation for threat hunting, and translating research into detection and protection.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Non-entry-level threat researcher investigating software supply-chain threats, analyzing malware in open-source ecosystems, building automation for threat hunting, and translating research into detection and protection.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 3+ years of work experience and a master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
- Technical experience across several areas of security operations, not necessarily every area listed.
- Experience building security automation, data collection, or threat-hunting tools.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Familiarity with TypeScript/JavaScript and/or other programming languages and ecosystems protected by Socket.
- Experience leveraging LLMs or AI-based tools for threat detection.
- Experience building tools for automation, data collection, and threat hunting.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): United States. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
